scripts.build: ng build storefront && ng build admin
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/storefront/tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/admin/tsconfig.app.json && npm run typecheck:libs && npm run typecheck:spec
scripts.typecheck:libs: tsc --noEmit -p libs/api/tsconfig.lib.json && tsc --noEmit -p libs/auth/tsconfig.lib.json && tsc --noEmit -p libs/ui/tsconfig.lib.json && tsc --noEmit -p libs/i18n/tsconfig.lib.json && tsc --noEmit -p libs/theming/tsconfig.lib.json && tsc --noEmit -p libs/models/tsconfig.lib.json && tsc --noEmit -p libs/utils/tsconfig.lib.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint:format && npm run lint:boundaries
scripts.lint:format: prettier --check angular.json package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.spec.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts vitest-base.config.ts vitest.setup.ts playwright.config.ts scripts .github apps/storefront/tsconfig.app.json apps/admin/tsconfig.app.json apps/storefront/src apps/admin/src libs/api libs/auth libs/ui libs/i18n libs/theming libs/models libs/utils e2e
scripts.format:check: prettier --check angular.json package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.spec.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts vitest-base.config.ts vitest.setup.ts playwright.config.ts scripts .github apps/storefront/tsconfig.app.json apps/admin/tsconfig.app.json apps/storefront/src apps/admin/src libs/api libs/auth libs/ui libs/i18n libs/theming libs/models libs/utils e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:apps && npm run test:unit:libs
scripts.test:unit:apps: ng test storefront --watch=false && ng test admin --watch=false
